visualCharacteristics.purpose: Hero / promo banner with heading, tagline and CTA
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width banner. Default (home) style: photo promoted to a full-bleed background behind heading, tagline and CTA. Other styles via the Style select: solid banner without image, plain white, gradient with image bleeding right, and split layouts (text/image side by side, either order).

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: optional image (image + imageAlt). Row 2: richtext (heading, tagline paragraph, CTA link). Style select adds the option class

options.label: Gradient (banner, white text, image bleeds right)

reuseGuidance: Use for page-top heroes and promo banners with a heading, short tagline and CTA. Pick the Style that matches the image treatment.
